observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== Are ctools/key/oauth2_client/geocoder in sync core.extension.yml? ==="
for m in ctools key oauth2_client geocoder geocoder_address geocoder_field geocoder_geofield openculturas_openstreetmap; do
  if grep -qE "^  ${m}: " config/sync/core.extension.yml; then echo "PRESENT: $m"; else echo "ABSENT:  $m"; fi
done
echo ""
echo "=== All cross-module service autowires in openculturas_openstreetmap ==="
grep -rn "Autowire(service:" profile/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/
echo ""
echo "=== 'use Drupal\' (non-core) in that module src ==="
grep -rhn "^use Drupal" profile/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/src/ | grep -v "Drupal\\Core\|Drupal\\Component\|Drupal\\openculturas_openstreetmap" | sort -u
